API Spec 5L.limitation: The Pipeline material string does not select a product level, edition or standard. The materials registry provides clause/table numbers but not verified clause titles or a full publication title.
API Spec 5L.edition_difference: Repository metadata distinguishes product levels and canonical SI strengths from legacy snapshots. A free-text grade does not select or establish equivalence between them.

uses.basis: repository defaults; not qualified standard values
uses.limitation: Yield is imported from the canonical materials unit view. Density, modulus and Poisson ratio are modelling defaults; no normative clause is established for this group. Unknown grades fall back to a default grade. Separately, LineTypeBuilder.build uses material_props.get("DNVSTF101Fy", 450e3) when the yield key is absent; this uncited strength fallback is in kN/m2 and has no qualified standard basis.

All emitted DNV fields are listed, including the simplified strain limit and zero/null entries. Their units, solver sentinel semantics, edition applicability and clause basis require qualification; generation is not an acceptance verdict.

uses.basis: repository defaults; not qualified standard values
uses.limitation: Only breaking load has a standard attribution in the code. Mass, stiffness and hydrodynamic coefficients are not established as standard-derived; the nearby library references are not independent source qualification.

The relation is evaluated in the router unless breaking_load is supplied. The result is assigned directly to AllowableTension, without a cited design factor or an edition-qualified acceptance check. No formula coefficient is qualified here.
Enum membership is not grade certification or proof that the same grades exist in both referenced publications or all editions.
The schema accepts a material string and does not validate API product qualification. The builder fallback and materials registry determine the generated strength.
